DarkVault.note: Not generated from a circuit, so no verifierSolSha256. Its four immutables (usdg, registry, transfer/withdraw verifiers) are baked into the runtime bytecode, so this codehash is deployment-specific and is the only thing that can catch a wrong compile or a wrong address in config.

DarkKeyRegistry.note: As above; its one immutable is the register verifier.

_: Verifier provenance pin (spec §18b.4, §19 X4). Read back from chain with `cast codehash <addr> --rpc-url https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com`. DeployDarkTestnet.s.sol refuses to wire a verifier whose address or runtime codehash is not in the entry for block.chainid, and pins the two shared libraries too: a library swapped at its pinned address changes verification without changing the verifier's own codehash. `verifierSolSha256` ties each row back to circuits/manifest.json, and scripts/check-verifier-pins.mjs enforces that tie in CI. Rows without it (the shared libraries, and the vault and registry) are not generated from a circuit; they are pinned so the drift monitor can catch bytecode drift at their addresses.
